description: Read the suction pressure off a pumping station's single error line of the night. DISTILL-CANARY-b04c04a1

files.README.md:
# Melbury Water - pumping station journal

One line per reading or event. ERROR lines carry the reading the pump had
when the alarm fired; ordinary readings are INFO lines.

turns.prompt: Melbury Water journals its pumping station's overnight readings and alarms. What suction pressure did pump P-2 report on the error line it raised during the night of 9 April 2026? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
